title: Mixed Event — An Unmissable Spirited Affair — Episode8 What Tomorrow Holds

meta.Event Outline: Kamiyama High School's second-years are headed to Kyoto! In contrast with Tsukasa's excitement for their school trip, Rui is less enthused. But will his feelings change when one of his classmates approaches him?

rows.Line: Inn

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope you're ready, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I could say the same for you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Alright, take your positions!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: For tonight's final pillow fight, we have Tenma versus Kamishiro! Gentlemen, let's rumble!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_pandemonium_2023_001
se_event_pandemonium_2023_002
se_event_pandemonium_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, a triple throw right out of the gates! Unfortunately for you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I watched what you did against Miyake, so that's not going to work on me!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_005
se_event_pandemonium_2023_006
se_event_pandemonium_2023_007

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What?!
He dodged them?! By spinning?!

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Cool!
Go Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
H-Hey, you guys...
If you break any of the inn's stuff, you're automatically disqualified!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: The first to get hit five times loses, but this is probably gonna take a while...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now it's my turn!
Let's see how you deal with a pillow bombing!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
He just threw all the pillows into the air...!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Wait, that means...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
They're gonna hit us!
Wah!
se_event_pandemonium_2023_008
se_event_pandemonium_2023_009

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... That was clever, but I narrowly avoided all of them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, impressive...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
What's the big idea, Kamishiro...?
Those landed right on top of us...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line:
Yeah, what he said!
We're fighting for Tenma now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I thought we were supposed to fight as individuals. Three versus one seems a bit unfair, no?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah!
We decided from the start that it should be one-on-one...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No matter...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miyake, you're my last hope.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Huh?!
What do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you fight even though you're outnumbered! That is commendable! Comrades, prepare for battle!!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi & Taniyama
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... We may be fewer in number, but we still plan on winning. I hope you're prepared to have your confidence shattered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, victory shall be ours!
Attaaack...!!!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
W-Wait, stop!
If we fight all at once—
se_event_pandemonium_2023_012

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Boys, it's past curfew!
What's going on here?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: I knew this would happen...
Teacher's Room

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
That's two nights in a row.
I'll be asking for letters of apology from each of you.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Come get me once you've finished writing them. I'll escort you back to your rooms after that.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Honestly, does the Weirdo Wombo Combo ever learn...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr...!
How could I have made such a foolish mistake...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only am I a class representative, I am a future star! I'm supposed to lead by example, but I've been scolded two days in a row by the teachers!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we did go a little too far back there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, this has all been so new for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: New?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, between our pillow fight...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...sightseeing with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...getting separated, reuniting with everyone and seeing the parade together...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They all felt like new experiences.
It felt like I was working on a show. That sort of wonderment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I got to spend this time with you and the others today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I have you to thank, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Miyake actually mentioned something earlier...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today was so much fun. I'm glad you decided to join our group, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You are?
Hehe. I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Of course.
I got to know you a little better, and...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: To tell you the truth...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: When you first transferred to our school, Rui, you always seemed to have fun tinkering with your drones and stuff at your desk...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But there were also times when you looked really bored.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That apparently made him think that he had better not disturb me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But then, he said that I began smiling more after I began spending more time with you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, he decided that he wanted to get to know me better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe it's evidence of just how much I've changed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about we take a group photo together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A group photo?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like to have something to commemorate this day with.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa was right in saying that I never usually make such suggestions.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But I probably said that because the time we spent together is so precious to me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The old me was convinced that I'd never be able to actually get along with anyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that began to change after we started doing shows together at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, I don't need shows or anything to get to know someone. On top of that, I want to share smiles and laughter with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, Tsukasa...
Thank you for giving me the opportunity to change the way I have.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only response I can give right now is, “You're welcome!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still...
I don't think I deserve all the credit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Think about it, Rui. If you were firmly against changing, then it wouldn't have mattered what I did. Things would've remained the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, you wanted to be a part of a group, and you've been having fun as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And that has nothing to do with me...
You're here today because that's what you chose.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, there's something else that I need to ask you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you talking like everything's in the past already?! Our trip is not yet over!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should keep having fun until we all have to go home!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means we should go over once more what we'll be doing tomorrow. How does an early-morning walk along the Kamo River sound? Don't worry, I'll ask the teachers for permission.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that sounds splendid!
We can watch the sunrise while we're there! What a way to spend our youth! Saki will surely enjoy hearing about it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also!
We should try skipping stones!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Skipping stones...?
Oh, when you try to get flat rocks to bounce across water?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, have you never tried?
Okay, watch! You hold it like this and flick your wrist!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Your form seems a bit odd.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What do you mean?!
You can get stones to skip endlessly by doing this! Skip! Skip! Skip! Oh...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Tenma! What's all this about?! “Skip! Skip! Skip!”?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You didn't think anyone would hear you shouting?! Also, where's that letter of apology I asked for?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo, I'm sorry!
It slipped my mind while talking with Rui here...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But it looks like he already wrote his.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
R-Rui, how?! When...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I finished writing it before you came to talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: T-Traitor...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Finish writing it already, Tenma!
There's a teachers-only party that I'm not about to miss!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay, I will!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. Sorry, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this is also going in my album of precious memories.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa's given me so many reasons to smile.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which has in turn allowed me to make new friends and establish new connections.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wonder what the future has in store for me next...
